title: The second box, iii
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: Wednesday. Gully at the door, Between-Sundays style — December 2014, reversed. This time Wood opens it. That's the whole joke, and it isn't one.

panels.composition: The porch. GULLY with a coffee, at the door, the empty box at his feet. Knocking.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a stocky man in a canvas jacket knocking on a garage door with a coffee in one hand, an empty cardboard box at his feet

panels.composition: The door. Closed. The nose print. A beat.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a closed garage door with a small nose-print on the glass, no words
image.notes: December 2014's composition (dw_2014-12-15): Gully at a door that doesn't open. Held one panel.

panels.composition: The door opening. WOOD. The pup out past his legs to Gully's boots.

balloons.text: Checking you still open the door.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a man opening a garage door to a stocky man with a coffee as a small three-legged dog squeezes out past his legs

panels.composition: The two of them on the step with the coffee, the pup in the empty box, sitting in it now, claimed.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, two men sitting on a garage step sharing a coffee while a small three-legged dog sits inside an empty cardboard box, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: 2014's closed door, opened. 'I'm checking it still works.'
